Oṃ, salutation to the one whose nature is the sixty-eight great sacred fords, fields, and Bhairavas.
Oṃ, salutation to the self of the ninety-four mantras;
Oṃ, salutation to the source of the ninety-six additional [mantras];
Oṃ, salutation to Śatānanda.
Oṃ, homage to the one who has performed a hundred sacrifices; Oṃ, homage to the one whose eyes are like a hundred-petaled lotus;
Oṃ, homage to the one with a hundredfold army.
Oṃ, salutation to Śatadhṛti;
Oṃ, salutation to the one whose excellent weapon has a hundred streams;
Oṃ, salutation to the one whose abode is the thousand-petaled lotus.
Oṃ, homage to the one adorned with a thousand hoods;
Oṃ, homage to the Puruṣa with a thousand heads;
Oṃ, homage to the one with a thousand eyes.
Oṃ, homage to the Thousand-footed One;
Oṃ, homage to the one praised by the Thousand Names;
Oṃ, homage to the one who takes away the strength of the thousand-eyed one.

Oṃ, homage to the one whose seat is prepared by the king of serpents with a thousand-fold circle of hoods. Oṃ, homage to the one whose seat is prepared by the king of serpents bearing ten thousand hoods.
Oṃ, homage to the one restrained by the hymns of eighty-eight thousand floods of great sages.
Oṃ, homage to the one of great body;
Oṃ, homage to the great self;
Oṃ, homage to Caṇḍila.
Oṃ, salutation to the Bestower of Desires;
Oṃ, salutation to the Essence;
Oṃ, salutation to the Support.
Oṃ, salutation to the one consisting of the Vedas;
Oṃ, salutation to Heramba;
Oṃ, salutation to the one born before Skanda.
Oṃ, obeisance to the support of the beloved of the Lord of a Hundred Thousand;
Oṃ, obeisance to the one consisting of mind who is the support of a hundred thousand;
Oṃ, obeisance to the one pleased by the recitation of four hundred thousand.
Oṃ, homage to the one manifested in four hundred thousand ways.
Oṃ, homage to the one residing within the bodies of eighty-four hundred thousand living beings. Oṃ, homage to the one who resembles ten million suns.
Oṃ, homage to the one stainless as the rays of ten million moons; Oṃ, homage to the one who destroys ten million sacrifices; Oṃ, homage to the one who bestows the fruit of ten million sacrifices.
Oṃ, salutation to the bearer of the eight crores of Vināyakas beginning with Śivābha;
Oṃ, salutation to the one whose limbs shine, consecrated by seven crores of great mantras;
Oṃ, salutation to the one whose sandals are bowed to by the rows of thirty-three crores of gods.
Oṃ, salutations to the one served by infinite deities;
Oṃ, salutations to the bestower of infinite auspiciousness;
Oṃ, salutations to the one named Infinite.
Oṃ, homage to Anantaśrī;
Oṃ, homage to the giver of infinite and boundless bliss.
